title: View from Xiangshan — Wikimedia Commons
description: Stone stairs between large sandstone boulders on the forested Xiangshan ridge, overlooking Taipei 101 and the Xinyi skyline. The photograph does not establish the complete six-rock arrangement or cardinal direction.
author: Mliu92

supplementary.title: Ultimate Guide to Elephant Mountain in Taipei (象山, Xiangshan)
